stopRules: Pause immediately if tracking, form, or calendar confirmation breaks
Add negatives if irrelevant searches exceed 20% of the latest 20 clicks
Pause the campaign at 500 SEK with no completed audit
Stop at 1,000 SEK regardless of unfinished learning
Do not run Leadmap and Nomia simultaneously
scaleRules: Unlock reserve only after two qualified leads and one attended sales conversation
Qualified-lead cost must be 500 SEK or less
Release reserve in two 625 SEK tranches and stop if quality or cost deteriorates
